plugins.name: analyze-screen-feedback
plugins.description: Ground narrated macOS screen-recording feedback in local word timestamps, visible interface evidence, cursor motion, and explicit uncertainty.

interface.shortDescription: Ground narrated feedback in on-screen evidence
interface.longDescription: Align narrated macOS screen recordings with local word timestamps, motion, readable frames, visible interface objects, and explicit uncertainty.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this narrated screen recording and ground each spoken reference in visible interface evidence.

plugins.name: precise-terms
plugins.description: Transform verbose instructions into concise prompts and canonical technical terms while preserving every stated requirement.

interface.shortDescription: Compress instructions into precise technical terms
interface.longDescription: Rewrite verbose instructions as concise, high-signal prompts or identify canonical technical terms without dropping requirements.
defaultPrompt: Use $precise-terms to rewrite these instructions with concise, canonical technical terminology.

plugins.name: quantitative-grounding
plugins.description: Explicit-use skill for decision-useful quantitative structure across scale, comparison, likelihood, economics, uncertainty, and consequential empirical claims without numerical theater or false precision.

interface.longDescription: Explicitly invoke quantitative grounding to clarify analytical claims with useful scale, comparison, likelihood, economics, and uncertainty without false precision.
defaultPrompt: Use $quantitative-grounding to add decision-useful scale, comparison, and uncertainty to this analysis.

plugins.name: side-refresh
plugins.description: Refresh a side conversation from the current state of an active main Codex task without interrupting or mutating it.

interface.shortDescription: Refresh a side chat from the main task
interface.longDescription: Use Codex app task-list and task-read capabilities to refresh a side conversation from an active main task without navigating to, interrupting, or mutating it.
defaultPrompt: Use $side-refresh to summarize the active main task for this project.

plugins.name: voice-edit
plugins.description: An explicit-use Codex prose editor that improves clarity and cadence while preserving meaning, evidence, and the writer's supplied voice.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve your voice while tightening prose
interface.longDescription: Edit or audit prose with minimum-effective changes while protecting facts, uncertainty, citations, technical terms, and the writer's supplied voice.
defaultPrompt: Use $voice-edit to refine this prose while preserving its meaning and voice.

plugins.name: adhd
plugins.description: Run explicit, isolated parallel ideation in Codex, then score, cluster, reject traps, and deepen the strongest options.

interface.longDescription: Explore a problem through isolated parallel Codex sub-agents, score and cluster their ideas, reject attractive traps, and deepen the strongest options.
defaultPrompt: Use $adhd to explore this decision through isolated cognitive frames, then converge on the strongest options.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Unofficial, explicit-use Codex adaptation for terse replies that preserve exact technical meaning, safety, and required progress communication.

interface.shortDescription: Terse replies with exact technical meaning
interface.longDescription: Unofficial Codex adaptation of Julius Brussee's Caveman skill. It compresses replies while preserving technical accuracy, safety, approvals, and required progress communication.
defaultPrompt: Use $caveman to compress this reply while preserving exact technical meaning, safety, and required progress communication.
